retraction.reason: Re-read on 24 September under A14(6) against the bar that replaced M44b’s: a record earns its place by carrying at least one honest edge to anything already in the atlas, and nothing is written in order to keep one. The corpus is 859 active events across all five lanes, not the Portuguese core M44b judged this against. The second reason M44b gave stands and is not the Portuguese rule: what the item describes is twenty-two years of policy under several headings, not an event, and a record dated 1930 that runs to 1952 cannot take an edge that means anything at either end. The atlas now holds molotov-ribbentrop-pact and the Soviet records around it, so the neighbours exist; what does not exist is a record of a datable thing to wire them to. It would have to be divided before it could be reinstated, the way the Holocaust was divided this same day.
